feedback.problem: What are the dimensions of the matrix $Y$, where $Y=[\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{7} & 10 & -2 \\ -4 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & \sqrt{2} & -\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution: The matrix $Y$ has $3$ rows and $3$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $3\times 3.$
